Parker: noticed a small canary billing blip. model downgraded mid-stream, stream truncated, client retried and we got a duplicate toolcall. provisional + confirmed both rose.
Devin: trace?
Parker: /console/trace/6123456789. router log snippet:
```
[router] ts=6123456789 req=rid-612 route=policy-v2 -> model-small handoff
[proxy] ts=6123456790 retry=1 toolcall=img.gen truncated=true
```
Devin: looks like retry didn't carry dedupe id. Ledger counted stream tokens + toolcall tokens.
Arjun: idea: add internal headers `x-rw-origin-id` and `x-rw-route-v` on handoffs. Ledger dedupe rule: same origin+route within 2m -> collapse provisional credits.
Nina: console: add route_v column and origin filter for support lookup; also show a small note about canary rollouts causing provisional duplicates.
Devin: proxy will reject duplicate toolcall if dedupe key exists (409-esque) and return pointer to prior result. tests: unit + e2e sim truncated retry.
BillingBot: alert: provisional spike +1.8k tokens tenant=gamma at 6123456792 tag:route_v=2
Parker: action owners: Arjun(schema+d ease), Devin(proxy+tests), Nina(console). Feature-flag rollout 10% 48h. Meet 3pm to review metrics.
Arjun: will draft migration with origin_id (string), route_v (int), dedupe_key index.
Parker: security note: headers internal-only, validate at edge.
Devin: will add toggleable provisional smoothing in dashboard to mute noisy spikes.
Parker: thanks team, closing for now.
